## About
We're a family owned and operated shop in Buena Park. Our customers are mainly people who've been here before and folks they sent our way, and we think the finished car is the best way to earn that.
Our team includes ASE certified auto body specialists, paint specialists and detailers. We repair foreign and domestic vehicles, aiming to return each one to its pre-accident condition in safety, function and appearance.
Our office staff works with all insurance companies and can help you get a rental car while yours is with us. We're rated 4.5 from 50 Google reviews.

## Services
- Collision repair, auto body and paint: Body, structural and refinishing work to bring foreign and domestic vehicles back to pre-accident condition.
- Insurance claim filing: We help with filing your insurance claim so the paperwork is handled.
- 24 hour towing: Towing is available around the clock.
- Detailing: Our shop staff includes detailers, so your car can leave cleaner than it came in.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with my insurance company?
A: Yes. We work with all insurance companies and guide you before, during and after the repairs.

Q: Do you give free estimates?
A: Yes. Call us or stop by the shop on Orangethorpe Ave for a free estimate.

Q: How do I get around while my car is being fixed?
A: We offer a complimentary shuttle service to our customers.
